title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Do all generic reflected caustics of every order in an ellipse have exactly four cusps, and does having this property for interior light sources characterize ellipses?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200016 (AMR-051-0016). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Serge Tabachnikov, Problem 4, p. 12.
